title: AFK Automation and Multi Utility Client
features:
Meerly PE v4 is an all-in-one Roblox utility client with Speed Changing, automation and macro tools, performance controls, AFK safety features, memory protection actions, configurable themes, live console logging, and a 5-slot config system for saving/loading user presets.

This Script can make your AFK times jump from the standard 20 minute idle time all the way up to 20+ hours with a golden standard on stability. I have coded over a dozen performance tweaks to improve lasting AFK and Automation specially designed for the game Peak Evolution!


Extra Details:

There is a work.ink Key-chain where you will need to watch / skip ads, but once you have completed it you get a permanent key - this key will always work for this script!
